name: honed
description: A quality-first engineering skill and deterministic AI-slop detector for AI coding agents. Build software that is simple, secure, maintainable, reliable, and ready for production.
author: hapheus

scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --format esm && chmod +x dist/cli/index.js
scripts.build: bun run build:skills && bun run build:cli
scripts.detect:self: bun run src/cli/index.ts detect src scripts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run detect:self
